name: lumbar_spine_compression
description: Verification scaffold for lumbar vertebral-body compression: single-voxel-column analytical reference and trabecular modulus law.

model.geometry: prismatic column, 10x10 mm cross-section, 20 mm height, 2 mm voxels

materials.trabecular: E = 6850 * rho^1.49 [MPa] at rho = 0.3 g/cm3 (screening osteoporotic range)

metrics.name: trabecular_modulus_mpa
metrics.note: E = 6850 * 0.3^1.49 = 1266 MPa; tolerance guards the power-law evaluation

metrics.name: uniform_column_axial_displacement_mm
metrics.note: delta = F*L/(A*E) = 500*20/(100*1266) for the trabecular column; linear field is exact for Q1 hexes

notes: The Q1 hex core reproduces uniform compression exactly (patch test class).
Follow-up: replace with the OSF/literature validated vertebral model when curated data land (see rfcs/0002).
